verdict.rationale: x402 documents an end-to-end agent payment flow: the server quotes a price, the agent signs and retries with proof of payment, the facilitator verifies and settles, and the resource is returned with confirmation. Agentic Wallets give the agent its own funds to pay from, and one integration line says merchant checkouts built on Payment Acceptance can be x402-enabled so agents authorize payment sessions directly. However, x402 is built around per-request resource payments 'without checkout pages', and the merchant-checkout path rests on a single thin mention. Missing for 10: documented checkout-session creation for merchant purchases, a delegated or scoped payment credential beyond agent-held wallet funds, confirmed order objects rather than resource-delivery confirmation, and hands-on evidence of an agent completing a merchant checkout.
